feed_summary: The Thoma Bravo-owned Proofpoint will acquire Varonis in an all-cash transaction and Varonis will become a private company. The post Proofpoint Inks $6.3 Billion All-Cash Deal to Acquire Varonis appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Proofpoint Inks $6.3 Billion All-Cash Deal to Acquire Varonis
